customer.business: NORTHLINE (working name): an online-only everyday clothing brand
customer.target: Style-conscious people aged 18 to 34 who buy basics (tees, hoodies, jeans, jackets) online and care about fabric quality and fair prices
customer.where: Online, shipping within the United States

behaviours.name: Fast-fashion regular
behaviours.how: Buys cheap trendy pieces often from big chains and sites like Shein or H&M.

behaviours.name: Quality-over-quantity
behaviours.how: Buys fewer, better pieces and checks fabric weight and reviews.

behaviours.name: Brand-name loyalist
behaviours.how: Sticks to a few known brands (Nike, Uniqlo, Carhartt) and trusts them.

behaviours.name: Deal hunter
behaviours.how: Waits for sales and discount codes, rarely pays full price.

behaviours.name: Social-proof buyer
behaviours.how: Buys what friends or creators wear and posts about it.

behaviours.name: Thrift and resale shopper
behaviours.how: Buys secondhand on Depop or Vinted and compares every price to that.

behaviours.name: Fit-anxious online shopper
behaviours.how: Has been burned by wrong sizes and returns; hesitant to buy online.

objections: I have never heard of this brand
$38 for a plain tee is more than I pay at Uniqlo or H&M
I can't try it on, what if the size is wrong?
How do I know the quality is really better?
Shipping costs and returns worry me
I would rather buy from a brand I already trust
habits: you scroll Instagram and TikTok most evenings
you buy about one clothing item a month, mostly online
you check reviews and photos from real customers before buying
you have a hoodie you wear almost every week

pitch:
NORTHLINE, a new online clothing brand making everyday basics from quality fabrics at fair prices.
Heavyweight Tee (240gsm organic cotton, boxy fit) $38. Classic Hoodie (brushed fleece) $78. Relaxed Jeans $92. Coach Jacket $120. Full range $28 to $160.
Order online only, shipped to your door. Launch offer: 15% off your first order.
